focus: PF-045 source-vintage admission and causal-lineage replay; not another partial-identification lower-bound derivation

hypotheses.claim: Same-decision PCF/units can be joined only after both exact first-known and capture clocks pass the decision cutoff.
hypotheses.support: Both source receipts can describe one bounded modeled basket context.
hypotheses.falsification: Later T-day retransmission or later capture can revise PCF without being known at earlier decision.
hypotheses.alternative: A stale prior-vintage PCF may look stable while wrong use-date.
hypotheses.failure: Missing/after-decision timestamp, wrong use-date, missing hash, incomplete support.

hypotheses.claim: ETF units plus PCF imply modeled delivery exposure, never actual same-day constituent market execution.
hypotheses.support: In-kind basket specifies possible delivery obligations.
hypotheses.falsification: AP inventory, pooled creation, cash substitution, borrowing and next-day fulfillment permit identical units/PCF without same-day buying.
hypotheses.alternative: Secondary-market ETF turnover, benchmark rebalance or valuation move.
hypotheses.failure: Cash-only, all cash substitution, unresolved corporate action, no AP trade receipts.

hypotheses.claim: Borrowing/shorting, ETF basket and crowding can share a causal event; source-specific primitives must not be counted as independent alpha.
hypotheses.support: Distinct official receipts can measure distinct aspects of liquidity demand.
hypotheses.falsification: Borrow-to-deliver can accompany creation without directional short, and multiple consumer labels can reuse one source primitive.
hypotheses.alternative: Hedge, arbitrage, financing, unrelated simultaneous trades.
hypotheses.failure: No event identity / exact parent lineage / comparable population.

hypotheses.claim: Source replay and clock controls are necessary but not sufficient for OOS incremental value.
hypotheses.support: Versioned receipts allow later forward-only tests.
hypotheses.falsification: Independent receipt count is not independent market dates; selection on liquidity and outcome leakage can inflate apparent effect.
hypotheses.alternative: Price-volume, institutional flows, index changes, volatility and market regime.
hypotheses.failure: No pre-registered common support, purge, date clustering, costs and regime stratification.

rules.admission: Fail-closed when firstKnownAt/capturedAt later than decision, sourceDate future, PCF useDate mismatch, missing provenance, unresolved corporate action, incomplete support, cash-only or all-cash substitution.
rules.allowed: MODELED_ONLY context, no directionality, no actual execution claim.
rules.unknown: UNKNOWN never zero or BAD; no true lendable-inventory denominator => true utilization UNKNOWN.
rules.eventLineage: Same primitive receipt many consumers counts once; distinct receipts with common cause cannot automatically be independent votes.
rules.antiLeak: No retroactive PCF overwrite; same decision generation version updates do not increase independent date N.
rules.validation: Future OOS / walk-forward, purge overlapping outcomes, date clustering, preregistered M0/M1, multiplicity, turnover/impact/fees, liquidity, regime and redundancy; outcomes unopened.
